integrity: Proof uses an exact 16-state paired-input transfer matrix, symbolic determinant, and a spectral/Fourier local limit. Reproducibility scripts and captured outputs accompany the statement. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One-update ordered-pair collisions on labelled cyclic binary rings and half-filling asymptotics only. The 2004 de Bruijn conference chapter could not be read in full; an earlier equivalent result cannot be excluded. Exact finite checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.
title: Density-resolved collision law and half-filling amplification for cyclic Rule 184
